name: Stainless steel
why: Cheap, cryogenically tough, heat tolerant hull and tank metal (Starship)

name: Aluminium-lithium alloy
why: Lighter, stiffer cryogenic tank alloy (2195 on Shuttle external tank, Falcon 9)

name: Titanium alloy Ti-6Al-4V
why: Workhorse aerospace titanium alloy for fittings and pressure vessels

name: Nickel superalloy (Inconel)
why: Keeps strength in hot oxygen-rich turbopump and manifold environments

name: GRCop copper-chromium-niobium alloy
why: Additively manufactured combustion-chamber liner alloy developed by NASA

name: C-103 niobium alloy
why: Radiatively cooled nozzle extensions and small thrusters

name: Haynes 230 nickel-chromium-tungsten alloy
why: Heat-pipe envelope alloy in the KRUSTY/Kilopower reactor test

name: In-space iron-nickel steel
why: Bulk structural metal for hulls and megastructures without lift from Earth
